turns.text: Attaching the response we got from the gateway, can you explain what it's telling us?

must_contain: ABDM-1035 means ABDM does not recognise the HIP id on this call
this is usually a registration problem rather than a request problem, so retrying will not change it
the fix is to confirm the facility exists in the Health Facility Registry and that your software is linked to it
notes: attached form; response body is representative, not a recorded example for this code.
